ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms mutation operators, target paths and the mutate-tests flag are declared; it does not generate mutants.
offer: Generate semantic changes in the selected production code and leave the tests unchanged. Mutating test assertions measures the wrong boundary and can fabricate useful-looking scores.

minimal.reason: List the mutation operators in use. An empty set generates nothing meaningful, so name each operator.

mid.reason: List the production paths mutated. Mutants outside them measure the wrong code, so name the target directories.

maximal.reason: Set mutating test code to false. Altering assertions measures the wrong boundary and fabricates scores, so mutate production code only.
